items.title: Gucci reportedly planning to cut around 30 jobs in Switzerland
items.summary: Gucci Swiss Timepieces will cut about 30 of 95 jobs at its Cortaillod (Neuchatel) site as logistics functions relocate to Trecate, Italy; a union secretary says the move aims to cut costs. Second wave of cuts after 21 jobs were eliminated in 2025; redundancies not expected before 2027.

items.title: Montres: Gucci supprime 30 postes a Cortaillod
items.summary: French-Swiss coverage confirms the Cortaillod logistics cuts (nearly a third of the 95-person site) moving to Trecate, Piedmont, and frames it within a broader Swiss watch-industry squeeze (strong franc, weak Chinese demand) also hitting Zenith, Breitling, Chopard and Montblanc.

items.title: Gucci watchmaking division cuts 30 jobs in Switzerland
items.summary: Trade-press confirmation of the Cortaillod cuts with sector context: Swiss watch exports fell in both 2024 and 2025, and the article cites a union representative's doubts about whether the ultra-luxury pivot is viable long term.

items.title: Gucci Price Cuts Break Luxury's Biggest Taboo. Louis Vuitton Isn't Following
items.summary: Analysis piece contrasting Gucci's up-to-30% list-price cuts on hero bags (e.g. Padlock, Mercato tote, sneakers) with Louis Vuitton's refusal to follow; Bernstein frames it as correcting a pricing bubble, while rivals like Louis Vuitton view repricing as a brand-equity risk.

items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: Confirms specific price cuts (Padlock bag -30% to EUR2,450; Mercato tote -20-25%; sneakers to EUR560-595) and 16 new sub-$2,000 handbag styles added in the US; Q3 revenue down 6% comparable with store traffic down 9%, weakest in China and Japan.

items.title: Kering: ce que la chute de Gucci coute a l'empire Pinault
items.summary: French financial analysis quantifying the cost of Gucci's decline to the Pinault family: Kering stock fell 16.6% in one session (Oct 23), Artemis holding lost over EUR1.8bn that day, and Gucci sales nearly halved from EUR10.5bn (2022) to EUR6bn (2025), with operating profit collapsing from EUR3.7bn to EUR966m.

items.title: Kering stock keeps focus on Gucci recovery after weak quarter
items.summary: German financial-wire note tracking Kering shares as investors continue to price in Gucci's slow turnaround after a weak Q3; flags Goldman Sachs trimming its Q4 Gucci organic-sales forecast to a 4.3% decline from a prior 1% estimate.

items.title: Gucci taglia il nastro del maxi flagship parigino in Avenue Montaigne
items.summary: Italian trade coverage of the new four-floor, 1,480 sqm Gucci flagship at 56 Avenue Montaigne, Paris, the first permanent rollout of the store concept previewed at the September SS27 Milan show, blending Italian-heritage architecture with the private Appartamento space.

items.title: Mariah Carey Checks In for Christmas in Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: WWD's editorial writeup of the Harmony Korine-directed holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, unveiling the Butterfly capsule (Starlet and GG Marmont bags, Paparazzo suede bag, Horsebit loafers) soundtracked by Carey's 1994 Christmas hit.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign
items.summary: Aggregates largely negative social-media reaction to the campaign, citing viewer comments calling it 'depressing,' 'boring,' and comparing the mood to a horror-show vampire party; quotes a fan: this feels like if JCPenney was trying to be luxury.

items.title: TikTok user reactions to Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday ad
items.summary: Specific TikTok comments quoted in press aggregation criticizing the ad's tone, e.g. a big name celebrity can't be the only thing the ad gives, and comparisons of the campaign's styling to a cheap imitation of luxury; original posts not independently locatable, counted via secondary quotation.

items.title: Gucci official X post: GENERATION GUCCI campaign shot by Demna
items.summary: Gucci's own X account promotes the Generation Gucci campaign shot by Demna spotlighting individuals who embody a new generation of the house; engagement metrics not retrievable (paywalled/blocked fetch), so reach/likes recorded as null rather than estimated.

items.title: Gucci SS27 Show (PurseForum community thread)
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread where members discuss and critique the SS27 Store Show runway/retail-concept presentation; thread remains the live community hub referenced by ongoing November retail-concept rollout coverage (Paris, Harrods), so retained as the community anchor for that storyline despite September origin; flagged as an aging thread rather than fresh news.

items.title: La branche horlogere de Gucci va supprimer 30 postes en Suisse
items.summary: French financial-wire syndication of the Swiss watch-division layoff story, read by France-based retail investors tracking Kering; reach counted toward the Cortaillod story's French coverage.

items.title: After price cuts at Gucci, Kering appoints a group director of pricing
items.summary: Reports Kering naming Francisco Ochando (ex-Nike, 11+ years) as Group Director of Pricing on 17 November, explicitly linked to the aftermath of Gucci's unannounced summer price cuts, read by some as an admission that pricing strategy had been mismanaged.

items.title: Gucci prasentiert neues Ladenkonzept auf der Avenue Montaigne
items.summary: German-language trade coverage of the new Paris flagship store concept, describing the four-floor layout and Italian-heritage design language; purely descriptive activation coverage, no independent critical assessment.
